heading: INT. ORBITAL GREENHOUSE RING - SECTOR NINE - CONTINUOUS

units.text: INT. ORBITAL GREENHOUSE RING - SECTOR NINE - CONTINUOUS
Rows of dead tomato vines hang from the ceiling racks like gray rope.
Emergency amber pulses.
A hull alarm drones under everything.
CAPTAIN IRENKA VOSS, 50s, rail-thin, flight suit patched at the knees, slams a manual valve wheel.
DUMISANI NKOSI, 30s, engineer, wedges a pry bar into a buckled bulkhead seam.
PELL, 20s, the botanist, hugs a seed vault to his chest.
Everyone, pressure in ninety seconds. Move your feet.
units.name: IRENKA

units.text: Hold the light higher. Higher!
units.name: DUMISANI

units.text: It's a tomato. It's just a tomato.
units.name: PELL

units.text: The bulkhead groans.
Dumisani and Irenka heave on the bar together and the seam shrieks open six inches.
A gust of cold air tears through, and all three duck, Pell clutching the vault, Dumisani losing his grip, Irenka grabbing his collar.
Nobody lets go of anything!
units.name: IRENKA

units.text: Breathe, breathe, breathe.
units.name: PELL

units.text: Captain, the vault is not coming through that gap!
units.name: DUMISANI

units.text: Then the vault goes first and we follow it.
units.name: IRENKA

units.text: She pushes Pell toward the opening.
Pell and Dumisani both freeze as the alarm changes pitch, a rising whine.
Irenka looks up at the ceiling vents.
She shoves them both through and dives in after.
